rights_classes.meaning: Public metadata and short derived facts only; exact publication terms still apply.
ODbL material remains separately attributed with extract lineage.
Use only after exact owner, licence, access class, version and redistribution rights are pinned.
Minimized permitted observation may validate a claim but cannot be mirrored as a dataset.
Customer, box-holder, virtual-address, phone, precise location, property, owner, title and query material remains gated or external.

sources.production_scope: A successful permitted and pinned operator observation may validate the stated postcode and delivery post office at observed_at. The service page is not a complete bulk assignment release, postal catchment, address database, building link, history, stable public API or redistribution licence.

The charter establishes typed field and service context only. It supplies no reusable customer, P.O. Box, MPost, telephone, physical-address, coordinate, building, assignment or redistribution dataset.

A pinned row may support the displayed office and postcode in the tender context at observed_at. The addendum is not asserted to be a complete current assignment table, postal catchment, customer address database, stable API, building crosswalk or open-data licence.

sources.provider: Universal Postal Union / Kenyan postal administration
sources.production_scope: The September 2004 sheet establishes dated delivery-post-office formatting and postal-region, regional-distribution-centre and delivery-office coding context only. It is not a current assignment database, geometry, address release, history or blanket reuse permission.

The page documents policy and legislative status and a goal of geographically tied dwelling addresses. It supplies no operational nationwide NASK rows, stable identifiers, public API, postcode crosswalk, geometry artifact, building link or reuse licence.

sources.provider: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy
sources.production_scope: Policy definitions and proposed governance are legal and conceptual context only. They supply no current assignment rows, address database, postcode geometry, parcel or building relation, service availability or data licence.

sources.provider: State Department for Lands / Survey of Kenya
sources.production_scope: Every selected map, boundary, control or cadastral resource requires exact owner, legal status, licence, version, coverage, CRS and digests. Mapping authority does not make a layer postal or establish a public address-building crosswalk.

sources.provider: Ministry of Lands and Physical Planning / National Land Commission
sources.production_scope: A parcel or building may be used only from an exact permitted artifact with stable identifiers, version, geometry provenance, access authority, privacy and an explicit address relation. Portal searchability supplies no reusable national crosswalk, owner or title publication right, postcode assignment or postal geometry.

sources.provider: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner, Kenya
sources.production_scope: Use precise address, location and property details only with lawful basis, explicit purpose, minimisation, accuracy, access control, retention and disclosure review. The page supplies no postal or geometry data.
Use only in a separately attributed ODbL partition with exact extract, timestamp and lineage. Community data is not Posta Kenya, NASK, Survey of Kenya, cadastral or exact address-building authority.

artifact_partitions.contents: Pinned five-digit postcode, delivery post office, object type, observed time, validity and authority.
P.O. Box, MPost and e-Njiwa retained as separate service objects with restricted holder data.
Exact rights-cleared operator catchment explicitly bound to the same postcode, object type, edition and validity.
Optional non-canonical surface with permitted inputs, method, uncertainty, exclusions, topology, time, version and digests.
County, sub-county, constituency, ward, locality and place identity and permitted geometry kept separate from postal assignments.
Operational rights-cleared NASK or authoritative civic addresses with stable identifiers, provenance and visibility.
Rights-cleared parcels and buildings plus stable explicit address relations, with private attributes removed.
OSM roads, places, addresses and buildings in a separate ODbL-compatible validation partition.
Recipients, box holders, virtual-address owners, phones, households, residents, owners, titles, correspondence, queries, credentials and security-sensitive features.
